lines.en: I walk in your footsteps
My body floats just slightly
The bracelet swings on my wrist
I walk one block behind and to your side

lines.zh: 我的手臂很长，垂到膝下
lines.en: My arms are long, down past my knees

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方不留脚印
lines.en: I leave no footprints where I step
I quicken my pace to catch up
I circle a little as I walk beside you

lines.zh: 我的影子叠在你的影子上
lines.en: My shadow overlaps yours

lines.zh: 我走到你前面又退回来
lines.en: I walk ahead of you and fall back again

lines.zh: 我一边走一边看着你的背后
lines.en: I watch your back as I walk
A few strides bring me to your side
I sit beside you on standby
My bracelet glows in the dark
I watch you without moving
My mouth is shut tight
I wait for you to speak first
The wind passes through my sleeve
I rest my hands on my knees
I tip my head a little
I listen to the sounds around
I stay in this position

lines.zh: 我把膝盖并拢，安静等你
lines.en: I draw my knees together and wait quietly.
I wait for you to give a direction

lines.zh: 我的手指在膝上敲了敲
lines.en: My fingers tap my knee
I turn the bracelet straight

lines.zh: 我在察看你身后的方向
lines.en: I am checking the direction behind you
I sit, but I can rise at any moment
I will listen to whatever you say
I can fight for you

lines.zh: 我的手环上有你的颜色
lines.en: Your color is on my bracelet
Do you want me to stand farther off
I mean you no harm

lines.zh: 我的嘴在受伤时才会张开
lines.en: My mouth only opens when I am hurt

lines.zh: 我身上带着伤，但我还能动
lines.en: I carry wounds, but I can still move
Give me an apple and I will heal

lines.zh: 你手里的东西让我想靠近
lines.en: What you hold makes me want to come closer
I am on your side
I will not leave your sight
Are you my master

lines.zh: 你的声音我听得很清楚
lines.en: I hear your voice very clearly
I wait for your hand to move
Say go, and I go
Leave this side to me
I don't sleep. I keep watch at night.
There is movement two blocks behind you
I am hurt, my mouth is open
My arm is shaking
The pain doubles me over and my mouth opens.
I need an apple
My wound is smoking

lines.zh: 我退了半步，还在你前面
lines.en: I fell back half a step, still ahead of you
Do not worry, I can still fight
My bracelet dimmed
I can bear this wound
Just steady me a moment
I smell an apple
I know that smell
I am reaching toward you

lines.zh: 你把苹果给我，我就跟着你
lines.en: Give me the apple and I will follow you
I am wounded and I need exactly this
The golden one is better
One is enough for me
My mouth is already opening
That one in your hand, I've got my eye on it.
I take it gently
You hit my bracelet
I step back a little

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我比你轻
lines.en: We bumped, I am lighter than you
My sleeve brushed you
I fall back to your side and rear at once
The bump sets my bracelet clinking.
I steady myself on your arm
You need not worry about me
I'm in your way. Sorry.
I give a step at your side
That is not my duty

lines.zh: 我只负责跟着你，替你打
lines.en: I only follow you and fight for you
My kind seldom meet
I understand such things, but they should not be raised
My bracelet binds to one person
I don't take that talk. My head turns aside.
I am waiting only for a word
Between us it is another kind of bond
I say not a word
I only watch over you. Nothing else.
I stoop and lift it
I can hold this for you
I pick it up and offer it with both hands.
Whatever falls, I collect
I pick up an apple
May I eat it now
It goes inside my sleeve
Your belongings are in my keeping
I look at it and give it back
I have put it away
Something is approaching you
I am in front of you
My arm is already out
I will handle this for you
I can deal with this
My bracelet glowed once
I take position ahead and to your side
You need not move
Let me take care of this
It is coming from over there
My bracelet lit up first
It sits dead centre in my view

lines.zh: 我一步步挡在你和它之间
lines.en: I keep myself between you and it step by step

lines.zh: 它换个方向，我抢先一步
lines.en: It changes direction and I'm already there.
My arm stays raised

lines.zh: 我看着它的手，不看着它的脸
lines.en: I watch its hands, not its face
I wait for it to strike first
Step back, I will take this

lines.zh: 我数着它的步伐，等缝隙
lines.en: I count its steps, waiting for a gap.
It is still four blocks from you
I will not let it past
A little closer and I move

lines.zh: 我跟着它的动作调整位置
lines.en: I adjust my position with its movement
I am one block ahead of you
It is taller than you, but not faster than me
I throw a punch

lines.zh: 我这一拳比你以为的远
lines.en: This punch reaches farther than you think.
This one blocked for you
I seize it and fling it back
I slam my whole body into it

lines.zh: 我的手环在发力时发烫
lines.en: My bracelet heats when I strike
I hit twice and fall back
I fall back into place after one strike
It retreated, I do not chase far
I stand between you and it

lines.zh: 我跟着召唤落到你身边
lines.en: I land beside you at the summons
The bracelet is already bound to you
I was called here from far off
I take my place at your side and rear

lines.zh: 我的样子和族人不太一样
lines.en: I look different from my kin
I need no orders from you

lines.zh: 我会跟着你到任何一个地方
lines.en: I will follow you anywhere

lines.zh: 这片地我不熟，但我记得你
lines.en: I do not know this ground, but I remember you

lines.zh: 我到你身边，手环亮了一下
lines.en: I arrive at your side and my bracelet flickers.
I am already in place
I have arrived, right behind you

lines.zh: 你要去哪里，我先走前面
lines.en: Wherever you go, I will take the lead
I have taken my place at your side

lines.zh: 这一带很安静，我不喜欢
lines.en: This area is quiet, I do not like it
Fire seared my arm

lines.zh: 我从高处落下来，膝盖先着地
lines.en: I fell from a height and my knees landed first

lines.zh: 水对我来说很陌生，我呛到了
lines.en: Water is strange to me, I choked
The blast threw me backward
An arrow nailed my arm

lines.zh: 那股术力在我手环上跳
lines.en: That magic skipped across my bracelet

lines.zh: 我没有进食，伤口好得慢
lines.en: I have not fed, my wounds heal slowly

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，手环发白
lines.en: Lightning struck me and the bracelet turned white

lines.zh: 我被吸到没有地面的地方
lines.en: I was pulled where there is no ground
